article.description: Jacob Wiley and Bogdan Bliznyuk each scored 21 points to propel Eastern Washington to an 83-68 win over Southern Utah on Saturday.
article.headline: Eastern Washington rolls to 83-68 win over Southern Utah
article.linkText: Eastern Washington rolls to 83-68 win over Southern Utah
article.story: CHENEY, Wash. -- Jacob Wiley and Bogdan Bliznyuk each scored 21 points to propel Eastern Washington to an 83-68 win over Southern Utah on Saturday. Felix Von Hofe added 12 points -- all from behind the arc -- for Eastern Washington (13-7, 5-2 Big Sky), which hit 10 of 20 from 3-point range and shot 52 percent overall. Wiley has scored at least 20 points in four straight games. The Eagles opened with a 16-5 run and never trailed. Wiley's 3-point play early in the second half gave Eastern Washington its largest lead, 61-31. Southern Utah (4-16, 2-5) used a 16-0 run capped by John Marshall's 3-pointer to trail 63-50 with 9:50 left before Bliznyuk ended Eastern Washington's scoring drought with a layup and the Thunderbirds got no closer. Randy Onwuasor scored 22 points to lead Southern Utah, which has lost five straight.
